title: Substrate Oxidation Does Not Affect Short Term Food Intake in Healthy Boys and Men
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate the effect of substrate oxidation, expressed by RER, on food intake regulation and net energy balance.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Born at full term
* Men Age:20-29 years/BMI: 20-25
* Boys Age 9-11/BMI percentile: 15th to 85th:

Exclusion Criteria:

* Smokers
* Dieters
* Individuals with lactose intolerance, allergies to milk and dairy products
* Individuals with gastrointestinal problems
* Individuals with diabetes or other metabolic diseases
* Individuals scoring ≥ 11 on an Eating Habit Questionnaire
